clips.title: The story
paras: Rot Blossoms grow among Duskwood's desecrated graves, fed by blighted soil and undead remains. Their foul alchemical properties make them sought after.

In Duskwood, Rot Blossoms grow in the defiled earth of graveyards such as the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Local rumors say the blooms can take root inside the cracked skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends stalking the barrows. For people in Darkshire, gathering them is grim and dangerous. Disturbing the soil means facing the unrested dead.

Rot Blossoms provide an ingredient for local brews. Their dark essences are needed to make Zombie Juice, a foul draft tied to Duskwood's efforts to survive. Those sent to gather the flowers often aid the Night Watch as they cut down restless skeletons wandering the haunted graves.
